name: Drought
value: E Africa, S Africa, Australia wheat hit
summary: El Niño drought threatens East and southern Africa and Australia's wheat
state: FEWS NET's October special report flags El Niño-driven drought risks in East and southern Africa through the season, and the IPC's 12 Oct Sudan alert says drought affects about half the country (WHO). NOAA's 29 Oct global hazards outlook shows persistent dryness in southern Africa. No harvest failure in a major exporter is confirmed as of 4 Nov.
for_you: No action needed in the UK. Drought in exporting regions can raise global grain prices later in the season.
rubric_hit: Severe drought in major crop regions = Watch; no harvest failure confirmed

sources.title: FEWS NET — 2026–2027 El Niño food security impacts
NOAA CPC — Global Weather Hazards Summary, 29 Oct

why: Drought slowly destroys harvests, hydropower and river shipping, and drives famine and migration.
drivers: Rainfall deficits, heat, ENSO, groundwater depletion.

rubric.alert: Drought driving famine conditions, a major exporter's harvest failure, or monsoon failure across a major breadbasket.
rubric.watch: Severe drought in a major crop region, a major river at record low, or a monsoon running more than 20% below normal.
rubric.normal: No major breadbasket in severe drought.
